stages.title: CONTEMPORARY INDIA ANCHOR — PLURALISM AS INTERFAITH PRACTICE [SUPPORTING]
stages.terms: Contemporary India anchor — pluralism as interfaith practice [SUPPORTING]: ⚠️ Inference: Public praise of interfaith harmony supports pluralism as an ethic of engagement, but it does not establish Hick’s metaphysical claim that rival religions are equally valid responses to one Real.

stages.title: VISUAL GATEWAY — FOUR QUESTIONS, NOT ONE
stages.terms: Visual gateway — four questions, not one: Master verdict: Pluralism is strongest when it combines realism about an Absolute with fallibilism about finite access, while openly admitting that some first-order truth-claims remain contradictory.
stages.mechanism: Inclusivism: one's own religion is the fullest truth, but other religions contain partial truth and their adherents may be saved through it (Karl Rahner's "anonymous Christians").
stages.consequence: The worry (2022): "unquestionable acceptance of only one Absolute Truth will inevitably result in religious exclusivism" → and exclusivism breeds conflict/intolerance. ✅

stages.answer: Vedāntic pluralism distinguishes one ultimate reality from diverse conceptual and devotional approaches, but unity must not erase genuine doctrinal contradiction.
